Installation

The latest version can be installed from GitHub or R-Universe. A CRAN release will eventually be planned.

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("IIASA/hibiiscus")

# Or from R-universe
install.packages("hibiiscus", repos = "https://iiasa.r-universe.dev")

Acknowledgement

The hibiiscus framework is developed by the Biodiversity, Ecology and Conservation group at the International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA), Austria.

The developers are grateful to the PREDICTS initiative and all data contributors for making available primary ecological data for broad scale analyses.

This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon Europe Research and Innovation programme under Grant Agreement No 101060423 (LAMASUS).
